title: VTG 1963 August Playboy Magazine Complete With Centerfold Phyllis Sherwood
descriptionText: The 1963 August Playboy Magazine is a vintage collectible featuring Phyllis Sherwood on the centerfold. This illustrated, 1st edition publication showcases a mix of women, art & photography, and men's interests with a focus on photography, art, and modeling. Published in the United States, this monthly magazine in English provides a glimpse into the cultural and artistic landscape of the time, making it a valuable addition for collectors and enthusiasts of vintage magazines.
